summary: A member takes a district hunger problem to a committee that handles farm surpluses.
realLife: David Luchins recalled Shirley Chisholm crediting a rabbi with helping her see how an agriculture assignment could serve hungry constituents. She worked with Bob Dole on food assistance.
inGame: needs: a food assistance proposal linked to district household needs and available farm stocks.

turns.what: The member seeks a different assignment after failing to connect farm surpluses to district needs.
turns.pulledBy: No local distributor will take the available crops.
turns.writesBack: The district request goes back to constituent staff.

turns.what: A distributor agrees to take a shipment for just one neighborhood.
turns.pulledBy: It has storage at one site and nowhere else.
turns.writesBack: The delivery reaches only the households served there.
